jobs.title: Director, Information Risk Management Strategy and Insights
jobs.description:
The Senior Director, IRM Strategy and Insights is responsible for a broad mandate supporting the Global Leader of IRM Strategy, Planning and Insights and the Chief Information Risk Officer in the Global Information Risk Management organization. Responsibilities for this role are global in scope and will provide exposure to senior leadership across all lines of defense within Manulife.

Primary Responsibilities

Senior Management and Board of Directors Reporting. Support IRM senior leadership in evolving reporting capabilities. Execute and deliver on plans for quarterly and annual reporting to Senior Management and Board of Directors, including collaboration with senior leadership across all lines of defense.
IRM Strategy, Planning and Governance Initiatives. Support IRM senior leadership in building roadmaps and implement processes, tooling, and reporting to deliver on IRM’s multi-year strategy, ensuring alignment with corporate and business objectives and focus on talent development and employee engagement across IRM.
Other Operational Support Initiatives. Lead and execute on new, evolving, and complex initiatives with abstract or

Required Qualifications

Minimum 6-years of experience with progressive leadership in the areas of Information Technology, Risk Management, Audit, or other related areas within a complex, global enterprise.

Strong time management and organizational skills to manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and changing priorities.
Ability to shift from high-level to detailed focus and from strategic thinking to execution in daily operations.
Ability to understand corporate strategic direction and operational challenges.

When You Join Our Team

We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.
As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Financial Planning & Analysis
jobs.description:
Winnipeg, Manitoba

We put our team members first. You’ll receive a great salary and benefits, and experience the support and opportunity you deserve. You’re empowered to make decisions. You control your future.

Job Description

Job Summary

The Senior Director, Financial Planning & Analysis is responsible for leading financial planning, performance analysis, and strategic financial decision support for The Boyd Group’s Corporate functions and enterprise-wide initiatives. Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis, this leader serves as a key financial advisor to senior leadership, providing the analysis, insights, and recommendations needed to support organizational priorities, improve business performance, and inform strategic decision-making.

The Senior Director leads Corporate FP&A activities, including budgeting, forecasting, expense management, workforce planning, and financial performance analysis. Working closely with Corporate functional leaders and Finance Business Partners, this role ensures financial plans reflect business priorities, establishes visibility into financial performance, and identifies opportunities to improve efficiency and resource utilization.

As a key partner to the SVP, FP&A, the Senior Director also plays a lead role in evaluating enterprise strategic initiatives and cross-functional business opportunities. This includes leading complex financial analysis, scenario modeling, business case development, and performance assessments to support enterprise decisions and measure the financial impact of strategic priorities. The Senior Director translates complex financial and operational information into clear, actionable recommendations for executive leadership.

Key Job Responsibilities

Corporate Financial Planning & Business Partnership: Lead budgeting, forecasting, workforce and expense planning, and financial performance analysis for Corporate functions. Partner with functional leaders to align resources, financial targets, and plans with business priorities.
Enterprise Strategic Initiatives & Financial Analysis: Lead financial evaluation of enterprise priorities, cross-functional initiatives, productivity opportunities, and business transformation efforts. Develop business cases, scenario models, and recommendations to inform decisions and assess financial impact.
Enterprise Performance Analysis & Decision Support: Analyze consolidated financial and operational performance, identify trends, risks, opportunities, and root causes, and work with Finance and business leaders to recommend actions that improve overall company performance.
SVP FP&A Executive Partnership: Serve as a trusted senior partner to the SVP, FP&A, coordinating complex cross-functional analysis and preparing executive-level financial insights, presentations, and recommendations for leadership reviews and strategic discussions.
FP&A Team Leadership & Capability Development: Lead and develop assigned Corporate and Strategic FP&A resources; establish analytical standards, set priorities, and strengthen financial modeling, business partnership, and executive communication capabilities.
Planning Process & Analytics Improvement: Improve the efficiency, consistency, and quality of planning, reporting, financial models, and analytics through process improvements, standardization, and automation.

Minimum Education And/or Experience Required For The Job

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, corporate finance, strategic finance, or a related discipline, including leadership responsibility.
Demonstrated experience leading corporate budgeting, forecasting, performance analysis, and complex financial modeling.
Experience developing business cases and financial analysis for cross-functional initiatives and enterprise-level decisions.
Experience partnering with senior leaders and leading or developing Finance professionals in a complex organization.

Required Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

Strong financial and business acumen, with the ability to connect enterprise strategy, operating drivers, and financial outcomes.
Advanced financial modeling, scenario analysis, forecasting, and analytical problem-solving skills.
Ability to lead ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives and turn complex findings into clear recommendations.
Executive presence and influencing skills, including the ability to constructively challenge assumptions and build alignment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including development of executive and Board-level financial materials.
Strong people leadership, prioritization, and organizational skills across multiple competing enterprise priorities.

Preferred Education And/or Experience

MBA, CPA, or other relevant advanced degree or professional designation.
Experience in a publicly traded, multi-business, multi-location, or geographically dispersed organization.
Experience supporting enterprise transformation, long-range planning, investment analysis, or strategic performance improvement initiatives.

Other Requirements

Ability to travel within the United States and Canada as business needs require.
Occasional travel and overnight stays may be required.
Specific travel frequency and other role requirements to be confirmed with the SVP, FP&A.

Please note, this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

The physical demands of your job must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the job.

Compensation Is Commensurate With Skill, Education And Experience.

This position may also be eligible for Bonus opportunities tied to individual or business initiatives

jobs.title: Head of Data Engineering
jobs.description:
Ambyint is a SaaS company that provides an Industrial IoT platform, leveraging physics-influenced AI models, plus closed-loop control to enable autonomous operations. As a result, we are an instrumental part of the climate technology evolution and a market leader in production optimization for the energy industry. We deliver step-change improvements to our customers by combining advanced physics, subject matter expertise, and data-informed insights with AI to automate operations and production optimization workflows. We’re coming off a strong year and are setting even higher ambitions for the future. To help us reach the next level, we’re looking for a Head of Data Engineering to join our team.

About The Role

As the Head of Data Engineering at Ambyint, you will lead the vision, strategy, and execution of our enterprise data architecture and roadmap. You will manage and empower a high-performing team of data engineers and data analysts, setting technical standards to support our market-leading artificial lift optimization platform.

You’ll be instrumental in shaping our long-term data strategy—balancing scalability, security, cost efficiency, and platform performance. Working closely with executive leadership, product managers, data science leaders, and software engineering heads, you will drive business outcomes by turning complex industrial data streams into scalable, reliable data products.

What You'll Do

Strategy & Architecture Leadership

Set the strategic vision and multi-year roadmap for enterprise data architecture, platform scaling, analytics, and streaming/batch capabilities.
Lead, mentor, and recruit a world-class data engineering team, driving career development and team performance.
Partner with executive leadership, Data Science, and Product to align data engineering priorities with business goals.
Drive the analytics and business intelligence strategy, delivering self-service reporting capabilities, executive dashboards, and enterprise data models.

Ops Excellence & Platform Governance

Establish enterprise DataOps standards, continuous integration/deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, and rigorous engineering practices.
Define and enforce data governance, quality frameworks, lineage, and metadata management across all data assets.
Own SOC2 compliance, data privacy, and security protocols across all data stores and cloud infrastructure.
Establish governance, semantic consistency, and quality controls across BI platforms and reporting models to guarantee single-source-of-truth analytics.

Financial & Resource Management

Manage the data platform budget, optimizing cloud warehouse consumption and other vendor tooling costs.
Oversee cross-functional delivery schedules, resource allocation, and technical debt management across pipelines and platform infrastructure.
Evaluate and select emerging technologies, vendors, and tools to maintain competitive technical advantage.
Optimize BI platform licensing, analytics warehouse queries, and dashboard reporting infrastructure to maximize ROI on analytics spend.

Data Strategy & Architecture

Develop and maintain the quarterly roadmap for Data Engineering and deliver ≥ 85% of committed quarterly roadmap milestones on time. Have stakeholders in data science, product, and engineering rate the data product use ≥ 4/5 in a semi-annual satisfaction survey for meeting their data needs.

Leadership & Team Development

Hit the approved hiring plan on schedule, with new hires fully productive within 90 days.
Keep annual regretted attrition under 10%, give every team member a documented development plan, and score at or above the company benchmark on team engagement surveys.

Governance, Security & Cost

Pass SOC2 audits with no data-related exceptions, with a governance framework (ownership, lineage, access controls) in place across all production datasets.
Manage the data platform spend within budget while lowering unit cost per well year over year.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
8+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, with 3+ years in a leadership, managerial, or staff/principal architectural role.
Proven track record of designing, deploying, and scaling enterprise data platforms handling high-volume IoT, streaming, and batch data.
Deep technical expertise in cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery), ETL platforms (Azure data pipelines, Fivetran, Stitch), and modern orchestration/transformation tools (dbt, Airflow, Dagster).
Strong background in financial management for cloud resources, compute unit cost optimization, and FinOps best practices.
Expertise in establishing DataOps processes, CI/CD frameworks, unit testing paradigms, and SOC2/data governance policies.
Demonstrated ability to build, manage, and scale high-performing engineering teams through effective hiring, coaching, and retention.
Executive-level communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into strategic business outcomes.
Experience managing end-to-end Business Intelligence (BI) platforms, data modeling for analytics, and working with modern visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker).

What Sets You Apart

The gratification of a job well done comes from the satisfaction of your ‘customers’
It’s in your nature to be efficient and do it really well, while you always deliver on what you promise
Your strengths come from collaborating with others
Continuous learning and improvement are part of your mantra
You are curious, creative, biased for action, and love solving problems
You don’t assume that you are the best and have the humility to learn from others

What Sets Us Apart

Ambyint is a scale-up company, possessing all the exciting edginess of a start-up with solutions that are proven and advancing daily. We pride ourselves on the strength of our team and company, and the positive environmental impact we are driving. We live by a simple and effective set of values.

What’s In It For You

The opportunity to make a difference in a cutting-edge technology company that is highly spirited and focused on being a leading contributor in the energy transition space. We offer an environment steeped in creating a rewarding professional experience and having some fun along the way. We work in a hybrid working environment with a diverse and talented team. We have a passion for taking on big challenges to create a wealth of opportunities and we will support your development and career goals. Additionally, we offer a competitive compensation and benefits package.

COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

At Ambyint, diversity, equity, and inclusion are at the core of who we are. Our commitment to these values is unwavering – across all of our work, teams, and interactions with customers. They are central to our mission and to our impact. The understanding that having varied perspectives and backgrounds helps generate richer ideas to solve the complex problems of a changing, and increasingly diverse world is paramount to who we are and how we work together as a team.

If you are a passionate professional that likes to work in a diverse team environment supporting an entrepreneurial culture with a focus on delivering exceptional value for our customers, we invite you to apply. This is your opportunity to join a growing company offering a competitive base salary and benefits.

jobs.title: Director, Finance (CSM)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Title:
Director, Finance (CSM)

Id:
21596

Type:
FullTime

Location:
Bolton, ON

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky Technologies TM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks.

Husky TechnologiesTM is committed to developing inclusive, barrier-free selection processes and work environments. If contacted in relation to a job opportunity or testing, you should advise the member of the Talent Acquisition team in a timely fashion of any disabilities that requires accommodation measures in order to enable you to be assessed in a fair and equitable manner.

Information received relating to accommodation measures will be addressed confidentially.

No agency or telephone inquiries please.
